correctness.rationale: For integer products B the centered overlap is 0 for B=0 mod q and (q-r)/(q^2 B) for remainder r=1,...,q-1, proved by enumerating every inverse branch. Positivity turns vanishing into divisibility of all words; prime valuations give a necessary and sufficient sharp cutoff. The weighted residue/reciprocal transition matrix proves the rational generating function. For q=6, mixed 2/3 words give zero while pure doubling and pure tripling give the exact displayed parity formula. Positive exponential terms have nth-root limit max(p/2,(1-p)/3), whose unique minimizer p=2/5 is elementary. Exact-rational standalone verification independently checked 1300 direct integrations, 220 matrix-vs-words, 72 special-law, 10 finite-cutoff and 208 invariance identities. All universally quantified statements are proved rather than inferred from finite tests.

originality.rationale: Original Suzuki beta-transformations and invariant densities are acknowledged. The most directly applicable earlier theorem, Aimino–Nicol–Vaienti (2013) Example 7.3, provides spectral gaps and a quenched CLT for random integer slopes, not arithmetic exact cell covariance or a switching optimum. The previous specific integer-beta work on zero asymptotic variance concerns a distinct nondegeneracy problem, not these two-time indicator correlations. A random-grid discrepancy paper for coprime integer maps concerns a different statistic. No checked material states or implies the exact rational-resolvent, valuation cutoff and q=6 optimizing profile as a package. Classical branch counting and transfer-operator machinery are not themselves claimed new. Equivalent unlocated Fourier treatments remain a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: The original beta paper was read by selected relevant sections and theorem statements rather than line-by-line in entirety.
Some comparatively less close published research sources were accessible only as summaries; full text might contain a stronger consequence.
Classical Fourier calculations for integer multiplication maps may yield an equivalent arithmetic cell-correlation identity under different terminology; independent historical review is required.

value.rationale: The stationary first-rational-cell indicator is a natural coarse observation of expanding dynamics; the formula exposes arithmetic aliasing invisible from the invariant density. The complete valuation cutoff is exact and sharp for every finite base set and q, and it distinguishes zero observable covariance from full stochastic independence. In the simplest coprime switching system, the observable correlation exponent has a unique interior cusp optimum p=2/5 with rate 1/5, smaller than both deterministic endpoint rates 1/3 and 1/2. This identifies a motivated quantitative mechanism of noise-accelerated mixing of that observable, beyond routine recomputation of a known table. No universal mixing optimality is asserted.
